simple.meaning: יָכֹל (yâkôl) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be able , literally ( can , could ) or morally ( may , might ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 194 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 13:6. Its contexts include city, land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָכֹל (H3201).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: יָכֹל (yâkôl) / H3201 is traced through Genesis 13:6, Genesis 13:16, Genesis 15:5, Genesis 19:19 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.usage: be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, (-not)), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer.
definitions.full: H3201. yakol יָכוֺל יָכֹל, 193 verb be able, have power prevail, endure (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic יְכִיל ; Assyrian akâlu , Hpt in KAT 2Gloss i ,) — Qal Perfect יָכֹל Gen 32:26 8 t.; יָכוֺל 1Sam 4:15 2 t.; 3 feminine singular יָכְלָה Gen 36:7 ; Exod 2:3 ; 2 masculine singular וְיָכָלְתָּ֫ 18:23 ; 1 singular יָכֹלְתִּי Gen 30:8 2 t.; suffix יְכָלְתִּיו Psa 13:5 ; 3 plural יָכְ֑לוּ Gen 13:6 27t. + Josh 15:63 Qr; יָכֹ֑לוּ Exod 8:14 2 t.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יוּכָל Gen 13:16 34t.; יוּכָ֑ל Job 4:2 4 t.; וַיֻּכָ֑ל Hosea 12:5 ; 3 feminine singular תּוּכַל Amos 7:10 2 t.; 2 masculine singular תּוּכַל Gen 15:5 16 t.; 1 singular אוּכַל 19:19 30 t., etc. (on these Imperfect forms as irregular Qal, see Ges § 2 , R. 3 Kö i. 407 W SG 237 ; others Hoph`al ); Infinitive construct יְכֹ֫לֶת Num 14:16 ; Deut 9:28 ; Infinitive absolute יָכוֺל Num 13:20 ; 2Chr 32:13 ; יָכֹל Num 22:38 ; 1Sam 26:25 ; P 8 t. (not Leviticus), Ezekiel 3 t.; often J E D Jeremiah, Isa 2 , not seldom in Samuel Kings Chronicles; — 1 be able , to do a thing, whether ability be physical, moral, constitutional, or dependent on external authority; usually of man Gen 13:16 (J) +, but also of gods 2Chr 32:13 , 15 , and of ׳י Num 14:16 (JE), Deut 9:28 ; Jer 44:22 ; occasionally of inanimate things Amos 7:10 ; Gen 36:7 (P), Song 8:7 ; Eccl 1:15 (twice in verse), etc.: a. usually followed by infinitive with לְ (122 t.), Gen 31:35 I am not able to rise up ; 45:1 Joseph was not able to restrain himself , 45:3 ; 48:10 ; Exod 7:21 , 24 were not able to drink , 12:39 ; Josh 24:19 (all E); Gen 13:16 if a man can number the dust , 19:19 , 22 ; 43:32 ; 44:22 , 26 (twice in verse); Exod 10:5 ; 19:23 (all J), Gen 15:5 ; Exod 15:23 ; Num 11:14 (all J E) + 10 t.
